# Prime Pick Entertainment

> Official website for Prime Pick Entertainment — a Bangalore-based multilingual production house creating original Telugu, Kannada, and Tamil short films.

## About

Prime Pick Entertainment is a creative platform dedicated to discovering, nurturing, and showcasing emerging talent in cinema and entertainment. We produce original short films, digital series, reality concepts, and entertainment formats. We also conduct entertainment research and publish filmmaking insights.

## Key Pages

- /                  — Home page with featured films, directors, and brand collaborations
- /films             — Film library with all released and upcoming short films
- /directors         — Profiles of independent filmmakers and directors
- /challenges        — Directors Challenge series — films born from creative constraints
- /journals          — Research papers, audience analyses, and industry insights
- /about             — Company mission, values, and pillars
- /contact           — Enquiry form and phone contact

## Core Services

- Short film production (Telugu, Kannada, Tamil)
- Directors Challenge program for emerging filmmakers
- Brand storytelling and branded films
- Entertainment research and audience analytics
- Digital content creation and influencer marketing
